title: gsbatch ingestion source configuration
description: Schema for classpath:ingestion/{sourceName}.yml files loaded by YamlSourceConfigLoader and mapped onto SourceConfig. Field names match the Java bean properties exactly (SnakeYAML bean binding, no snake_case translation).

configVersion.description: Format version of this YAML file. Optional - defaults to 1 (the only version so far). Exists so a future breaking format change can be rejected with a clear message instead of failing confusingly deep inside a reader.

name.description: Source name. Optional: if omitted, YamlSourceConfigLoader defaults it to the YAML file name (without .yml).

type.description: Source type. Case-insensitive at runtime, but use uppercase for consistency. Determines which of path/columns, sqlDirectory+sqlFile, rest, or soap is required below.

chunkSize.description: Spring Batch chunk size for the ingestion step. Defaults to 1000 if omitted.

path.description: Path to the CSV file. Required when type=CSV.

skipHeader.description: Whether to skip the first (header) line of the CSV file.

columns.description: Column definitions. Required and non-empty when type=CSV. Optional for SQL (explicit column mapping instead of JDBC metadata auto-mapping) and for REST/SOAP (drives JSON/XPath extraction and type conversion).

sqlDirectory.description: Directory containing the SQL file. Required when type=SQL. Resolved in order: absolute path, 'classpath:' prefix (e.g. 'classpath:sql'), then filesystem path relative to the working directory.

sqlFile.description: SQL file name inside sqlDirectory. Required when type=SQL.

fetchSize.description: JDBC fetch size for the SQL cursor reader.

dataSourceBean.description: Name of the Spring DataSource bean to use for the SQL reader, if multiple DataSources are declared. Defaults to the primary DataSource.

rest.description: REST API configuration. Required when type=REST.

soap.description: SOAP WebService configuration. Required when type=SOAP.

preprocessing.description: Optional tasklet executed before the ingestion step.

postprocessing.description: Optional tasklet executed after the ingestion step.

writer.description: Declarative writer configuration. If omitted entirely, the framework looks up a Spring bean named '{sourceName}Writer' (required in that case).

name.description: Column name. For CSV, matches the header/tokenizer field name. For SQL explicit mapping, matches the ResultSet column label.

type.description: Value type used for conversion. Required for REST/SOAP sources (a missing type fails fast at config load). Not used by CSV or SQL readers, which convert independently.

format.description: Format pattern used for DATE/DATETIME conversion, e.g. 'yyyy-MM-dd'. Ignored for other types.

jsonPath.description: JsonPath expression to extract this field (REST sources only). If omitted, the JSON key is assumed to equal the column name.

xpath.description: XPath expression, relative to the matched item node, to extract this field (SOAP sources only). If omitted, defaults to './{name}/text()'.

required.description: Whether this column must be non-null. Declarative only; not currently enforced by the readers.

defaultValue.description: Default value used when the column is missing or empty. Declarative only; not currently applied by the readers.

url.description: Base URL of the REST API endpoint. May contain ':paramName' bind variables resolved from jobParameters, and '${VAR}' environment variable placeholders.

queryParams.description: Query parameters appended to the URL. Values may contain ':paramName' and '${VAR}' placeholders.

headers.description: HTTP headers sent with every request. Values may contain ':paramName' and '${VAR}' placeholders.

body.description: Optional request body for POST requests (expected to be JSON). May contain ':paramName' and '${VAR}' placeholders.

dataPath.description: JsonPath expression selecting the array (or single object) of items in the response body.

type.description: OAUTH2_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS passes config validation but is not yet implemented (RestGenericItemReaderBuilder throws UnsupportedOperationException at build time).

apiKey.description: Required when type=API_KEY. Supports '${VAR}' environment variable resolution.

headerName.description: HTTP header name used to carry the API key (type=API_KEY only).

bearerToken.description: Required when type=BEARER. Supports '${VAR}' environment variable resolution.

strategy.description: LINK_HEADER passes config validation but is not yet implemented (RestGenericItemReader throws UnsupportedOperationException at read time).

cursorPath.description: JsonPath to the next-page cursor value in the response. Required when strategy=CURSOR. A null/absent cursor signals the last page.

totalPath.description: Optional JsonPath to a total-item-count field, used only for progress logging.

endpoint.description: SOAP endpoint URL. Must start with http:// or https://.

soapAction.description: SOAPAction header value. Required when soapVersion=1.1; optional for 1.2.

wsdl.description: WSDL URL, for documentation purposes only - not used at runtime.

requestTemplate.description: Inline SOAP envelope XML template. Must contain a recognized SOAP envelope tag. May contain ':paramName' placeholders resolved via requestParams. Namespaces must be hardcoded in the template.

requestParams.description: Maps template placeholder names to static values or ':paramName'/'${VAR}' expressions.

dataPath.description: XPath expression selecting the repeating item nodes in the SOAP response (evaluated against the full envelope).

namespaceAware.description: Set to false when the response uses a default namespace and dataPath/column xpath should match local names without namespace qualification.

username.description: Required when type=BASIC or WS_SECURITY. Supports '${VAR}'.

password.description: Required when type=BASIC or WS_SECURITY. Supports '${VAR}'.

sqlFile.description: Required when type=SQL. Must contain a single INSERT/UPDATE/MERGE/DELETE statement.

beanName.description: Required when type=JAVA. Must be a Spring ItemWriter bean.

enabled.description: If false (or absent), this step is a no-op regardless of the other fields below.

sqlFile.description: Required when enabled=true and type=SQL. May contain several ';'-separated statements run in one transaction.

beanName.description: Required when enabled=true and type=JAVA. Must be a Spring Tasklet bean.
